components.name: Square-basin rough-window recursion and high least-factor contraction
components.project_addition: Apply established rough-number and Buchstab least-factor recursion to the exact finite cofactor windows forced by consecutive-square geometry; combine the square-derived raw window width with quotient-response transport to prove a high least-factor contraction threshold p^2>=2k, binary second-factor branches, pairwise cofactor-support separation, finite three-prime resource bounds, and exact identification of the child branch bit with the earlier square-basin hit count H_(p*ell)(k).
